name: Ceruledge
description: Ceruledge, the Fire Blades Pokémon, and the evolved form of Charcadet. A Fire and Ghost type.
pokedex_entries: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon's evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
